"""RoboPaint 人: calibrated two-stroke trajectory. Run stages separately so the first stroke can be inspected."""
import sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import label
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

MM_PER_PX = 0.227185 / 1024
SHEET_EDGE = 0.227185 / 2
PAPER_Z = 0.0202
INK = (-0.1, 0.15)
HOVER_Z = 0.08
TARGET = np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('L')) < 100
COMP, _ = label(TARGET)

def pixel_world(u, v):
    return np.array([0.0135925 - (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
                     0.1135925 - (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX])

def po(x, y, z, q):
    return np.array([x, y, z, *q])

def redip(r, q):
    a = [po(INK[0], INK[1], z, q) for z in [0.04, 0.018, 0.018, 0.08]]
    return r.submit('ee_pose', a, dt=0.5, cameras=['canvas_cam'], video='none', note='redip before main stroke')

def clear_view(r, q, stage):
    p=np.array(r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
    target=po(INK[0], INK[1], HOVER_Z, q)
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', np.linspace(p,target,11)[1:], dt=0.5,
                 cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam'], video='none', note='clear canvas after '+stage)
    Image.fromarray(res.last['canvas_cam']).save('/app/output/main_'+stage+'_clear.png')
    print(stage,'clear end',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True),'status',r.status(),flush=True)

def right_path(q):
    path=[]
    for u in np.arange(390,776,8):
        v=np.flatnonzero(COMP[:,u]==2)
        if len(v)==0:continue
        v=float(v.mean())
        width_mm=len(np.flatnonzero(COMP[:,u]==2))*MM_PER_PX*1000*.925
        press_mm=np.clip(width_mm/1.10,0.5,11.0)
        x,y=pixel_world(u,v)
        # Directional brush deflection measured on practice: 2 mm x, 4 mm y lead.
        path.append(po(x-.002,y-.004,PAPER_Z-press_mm/1000,q))
    return path

def left_path(q):
    path=[]
    for v in np.arange(335,610,6):
        u=np.flatnonzero(COMP[v]==1)
        if len(u)==0:continue
        u=float(u.mean())
        width_mm=len(np.flatnonzero(COMP[v]==1))*MM_PER_PX*1000*.82
        press_mm=np.clip(width_mm/1.10,0.5,11.0)
        x,y=pixel_world(u,v)
        # Offset refined after comparing the two practice strokes.
        path.append(po(x-.0047,y+.007,PAPER_Z-press_mm/1000,q))
    return path

def run_right(r,q):
    redip(r,q)
    p=np.array(r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
    path=right_path(q);start=path[0]
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',np.linspace(p,po(start[0],start[1],.055,q),11)[1:],dt=.5,
                 cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none',note='right main approach')
    print('right approach',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True),flush=True)
    a=[po(start[0]-.001,start[1]+.002,.037,q),path[0]]+path[1:]
    end=path[-1]
    for f,z in [(.35,.0205),(.7,.029),(1,.05)]:
        a.append(po(end[0]-.003*f,end[1]-.006*f,z,q))
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.1,cameras=['canvas_cam','side_cam'],video='none',note='main right stroke')
    print('right stroke',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True),'failures',sum(d.get('ik_failures',0) for d in res.meta.get('plan',[])),flush=True)
    clear_view(r,q,'right')

def run_left(r,q):
    redip(r,q)
    p=np.array(r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now'][7:14])
    path=left_path(q);start=path[0]
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',np.linspace(p,po(start[0],start[1],.055,q),11)[1:],dt=.5,
                 cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none',note='left main approach')
    print('left approach',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True),flush=True)
    a=[po(start[0]+.001,start[1]-.001,.04,q),path[0]]+path[1:]
    end=path[-1]
    for f,z in [(.4,.0205),(.8,.030),(1,.05)]:
        a.append(po(end[0]-.004*f,end[1]+.003*f,z,q))
    res=r.submit('ee_pose',a,dt=.1,cameras=['canvas_cam','side_cam'],video='none',note='main left stroke')
    print('left stroke',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True),'failures',sum(d.get('ik_failures',0) for d in res.meta.get('plan',[])),flush=True)
    clear_view(r,q,'both')

if __name__=='__main__':
    stage=sys.argv[1]
    r=Robot();q=np.array(r.get_obs().meta['proprio']['now'][10:14])
    if stage=='right':run_right(r,q)
    elif stage=='left':run_left(r,q)
    else:raise ValueError(stage)
